pages.faq:
問

FAQ

I know zero Japanese. Where do I start?

With the kana quiz and the Absolute beginner course. It assumes nothing.

How long until I can hold a conversation?

Most learners manage simple conversations after 8–12 weeks at 10 minutes a day.

Is there a romaji version?

Yes, romaji and furigana can be turned on or off per lesson.
